definition_en: to think that something will happen; to believe someone should do something; to be waiting for a person or event
core_image: 朝着前方张望，心里等着某件事发生
scene: 我们预计火车会晚点到达。We expect the train to arrive late.
sceneCN: 这里 expect 是「预料、预期」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我们预计火车会晚点到达。

senses.title: Think it will happen
senses.definition: to think that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事将会发生
senses.example: We expect rain before evening.
senses.exampleCN: 我们预计傍晚前会下雨。
senses.why: The core sense is looking forward in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是在心里向前张望。

senses.title: Believe someone should
senses.definition: to believe that someone should do something
senses.definitionCN: 认为某人应该做某事
senses.example: The teacher expects us to be on time.
senses.exampleCN: 老师期望我们准时。
senses.why: A prediction becomes a standard for others.
senses.whyCN: 预测变成了对他人的要求标准。

senses.title: Wait for
senses.definition: to be waiting for a person or event
senses.definitionCN: 等着某个人或某件事到来
senses.example: She is expecting a call from her brother.
senses.exampleCN: 她正等着哥哥的电话。
senses.why: Looking forward becomes active waiting.
senses.whyCN: 向前张望变成了主动等待。

intro.en: Expect comes from Latin exspectare, to look out for.
intro.cn: expect 源自拉丁语 exspectare，意为「向外张望、等候」。

items.en: Exspectare joins ex- (out) with spectare (to look).
items.cn: exspectare 由 ex-（向外）与 spectare（看）构成。

items.en: Spectare means to watch or look at.
items.cn: spectare 意为观看、注视。

items.en: Exspectare means to look out for something.
items.cn: exspectare 意为留意等候某事。

items.en: Expecten carries the sense of waiting.
items.cn: expecten 带有等候的含义。

items.en: Expect adds the belief that something will happen.
items.cn: expect 增加了「认为某事会发生」的含义。

items.en: Expect to is a very common pattern.
items.cn: expect to 成为非常常见的搭配。

note.en: Expect is about the future; inspect is about looking closely.
note.cn: expect 面向未来，inspect 则是仔细查看。

entries.definition: to think someone may be guilty
to expect and prepare for something
to think something is probably true

normalIntro.en: Expect is looking ahead and thinking something will come.
normalIntro.cn: expect 是向前看，认定某事会到来。

normal.en: We expect the results on Friday.
normal.cn: 我们预计周五出结果。

normal.en: She expects her students to read daily.
normal.cn: 她期望学生每天阅读。

normal.en: The storm came earlier than expected.
normal.cn: 暴风雨比预料的来得早。

normal.en: He is expecting a parcel from abroad.
normal.cn: 他正等着一个海外包裹。

normal.en: Do not expect too much from one lesson.
normal.cn: 不要指望一节课能学到太多。

abstract.en: Picture someone watching the road for a bus.
abstract.cn: 想象有人望着马路等公交。

abstract.en: Imagine a clock ticking toward a known hour.
abstract.cn: 想象时钟走向一个已知的时刻。

abstract.en: Think of a door you are sure will open.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇你确信会打开的门。

examples.en: Economists expect prices to rise slowly.
examples.cn: 经济学家预计物价会缓慢上涨。

examples.en: Parents expect children to tell the truth.
examples.cn: 父母期望孩子说真话。

examples.en: The team was expected to win the final.
examples.cn: 这支队伍被认为会赢得决赛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expect」可拆成 ex（向外）+ spect（看）：向外张望，就是在「期待、预料」。

root: 拉丁语 exspectare 由 ex-（向外）与 spectare（看）构成，核心义「向外张望、等候」。

sensesIntro.en: Expect means to think something will happen, to require it of someone, or to wait for it.
sensesIntro.cn: expect 意为预料某事会发生、要求某人做到，或等待某事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: looking ahead toward a coming event.
core.cn: 核心意象：朝前方张望即将发生的事。

branches.en: The base sense is foreseeing an event.
branches.cn: 基础义是预见某事。

branches.en: Foreseeing becomes a demand on others.
branches.cn: 预见变成对他人的要求。

branches.en: Foreseeing becomes active waiting.
branches.cn: 预见变成主动的等待。

branches.en: Belief and requirement often appear together.
branches.cn: 相信与要求常常同时出现。

branches.en: Prediction and waiting share the forward look.
branches.cn: 预测与等待共享向前张望的姿态。

intro.en: Expect joins Latin ex- (out) with spectare (to look).
intro.cn: expect 由拉丁语 ex-（向外）与 spectare（看）组合。

latinIntro.en: Latin exspectare and spectare supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exspectare 与 spectare 提供核心词形。

items.example: Spectare gives the idea of watching.
Exspectare is the direct source of expect.
items.exampleCN: exspectare 是 expect 的直接来源。

items.example: Expect keeps the sense of looking ahead.
items.exampleCN: expect 保留向前看的含义。

items.exampleCN: expected 描述已被预见的事物。

definition_en: a belief that something will happen; a hope or requirement; the standards people expect you to meet
core_image: 心里悬着一个「应该会发生」的念头
scene: 她的表现远远超出了大家的预期。Her performance went far beyond everyone's expectation.
sceneCN: 这里 expectation 是「预期、期望」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她的表现远远超出了大家的预期。

senses.title: Belief about the future
senses.definition: a belief that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 相信某事将会发生的看法
senses.example: The result was beyond our expectation.
senses.exampleCN: 结果超出了我们的预期。
senses.why: The noun names the belief itself.
senses.whyCN: 名词形式指这种信念本身。

senses.title: Hope or requirement
senses.definition: a strong hope that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 强烈希望某事发生
senses.example: She has high expectations for her students.
senses.exampleCN: 她对学生们抱有很高的期望。
senses.why: Belief becomes a wish or a demand.
senses.whyCN: 信念变成愿望或要求。

senses.title: Standards to meet
senses.definition: the standards that people expect you to meet
senses.definitionCN: 人们期待你达到的标准
senses.example: He struggled to meet the expectations of the job.
senses.exampleCN: 他努力想达到这份工作的要求。
senses.why: A hope hardens into a social standard.
senses.whyCN: 希望固化为社会标准。

intro.en: Expectation comes from Latin exspectatio, a looking out for.
intro.cn: expectation 源自拉丁语 exspectatio，意为「向外张望、等候」。

items.en: Exspectatio is the noun of exspectare.
items.cn: exspectatio 是 exspectare 的名词形式。

items.en: Exspectare means to look out for something.
items.cn: exspectare 意为留意等候某事。

items.en: Expectacion keeps the sense of waiting.
items.cn: expectacion 保留等候的含义。

items.en: Expectacioun names a looking forward.
items.cn: expectacioun 指向前张望。

items.en: Expectation adds the sense of a demand.
items.cn: expectation 增加了「要求」之义。

items.en: Expectations often means standards to meet.
items.cn: expectations 常指需要达到的标准。

note.en: Expectation is what you believe will happen; an exception is something left out.
note.cn: expectation 是你相信会发生的事，exception 则是例外。

entries.definition: a case not included in a rule
a view of what may happen

normalIntro.en: Expectation is the noun for what you think will happen.
normalIntro.cn: expectation 是表示「你认为会发生什么」的名词。

normal.en: The film exceeded all our expectations.
normal.cn: 这部电影超出了我们所有的预期。

normal.en: Parents often place high expectations on children.
normal.cn: 父母常对孩子寄予厚望。

normal.en: Against all expectations, the team won.
normal.cn: 出乎所有人意料，这支队伍赢了。

normal.en: The new restaurant did not meet expectations.
normal.cn: 这家新餐厅没有达到预期。

normal.en: Her expectation of a quiet evening was ruined.
normal.cn: 她想要安静夜晚的期望落空了。

abstract.en: Picture a closed box you believe is full.
abstract.cn: 想象一个你相信装满东西的盒子。

abstract.en: Imagine a path that leads to a guessed door.
abstract.cn: 想象一条通往猜测之门的道路。

abstract.en: Think of a score card waiting to be filled.
abstract.cn: 想象一张等着填分的记分卡。

examples.en: The quality of the meal went beyond expectation.
examples.cn: 这顿饭的品质超出了预期。

examples.en: She had little expectation of winning the prize.
examples.cn: 她几乎没指望能得奖。

examples.en: The job failed to meet his expectations.
examples.cn: 这份工作没能达到他的期望。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expectation」由 expect（期待）加 -ation 构成：期待这件事本身，就是「预期」。

root: 拉丁语 exspectare（向外张望、等候）的名词形式 exspectatio 进入英语，核心义「所期待之事」。

sensesIntro.en: Expectation means a belief about the future, a hope, or the standards others set for you.
sensesIntro.cn: expectation 意为对未来的预期、一种希望，或他人为你设定的标准。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thought fixed on a coming result.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个念头锁定在即将到来的结果上。

branches.en: The base sense is a belief about the future.
branches.cn: 基础义是对未来的信念。

branches.en: The belief becomes a strong hope.
branches.cn: 信念变成强烈的希望。

branches.en: The hope becomes a standard to meet.
branches.cn: 希望变成需达到的标准。

branches.en: Prediction and hope share one forward look.
branches.cn: 预测与希望共享同一种向前看。

branches.en: Personal hope and social standard are linked.
branches.cn: 个人希望与社会标准相互关联。

intro.en: Expectation adds the noun suffix -ation to expect.
intro.cn: expectation 在 expect 后加名词后缀 -ation。

latinIntro.en: Latin exspectare and exspectatio are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exspectare 与 exspectatio 是来源词形。

items.exampleCN: expectant 加上了形容词词尾。

definition_en: the amount of money spent; the act of spending money; the use of time or energy
core_image: 一笔钱被称量后付出去
scene: 政府计划削减明年的公共开支。The government plans to cut public expenditure next year.
sceneCN: 这里 expenditure 是「支出、经费」（第 1 个义项）；句意：政府计划削减明年的公共开支。

senses.title: Money spent
senses.definition: the amount of money that is spent
senses.definitionCN: 花出去的钱的总额
senses.example: Public expenditure rose sharply last year.
senses.exampleCN: 去年公共开支大幅上升。
senses.why: The noun names money paid out.
senses.whyCN: 名词形式指付出去的钱。

senses.title: Budget item
senses.definition: a particular sum of money used for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为某一用途拨出的一笔钱
senses.example: The school increased its expenditure on books.
senses.exampleCN: 学校增加了购书经费。
senses.why: Money paid out is organized into budget items.
senses.whyCN: 支出的钱被归入预算项目。

senses.title: Use of energy
senses.definition: the use of time, energy, or effort
senses.definitionCN: 时间、精力或努力的使用
senses.example: The project required a huge expenditure of energy.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目需要消耗巨大的精力。
senses.why: Spending extends from money to effort.
senses.whyCN: 「花费」从金钱扩展到精力。

intro.en: Expenditure comes from Latin expendere, to weigh out and pay.
intro.cn: expenditure 源自拉丁语 expendere，意为「称量后付出」。

items.en: Expendere means to weigh out and pay.
items.cn: expendere 意为称量后支付。

items.en: It joins ex- (out) with pendere (to weigh).
items.cn: 它由 ex-（向外）与 pendere（称量）构成。

items.en: Expenditura names money paid out.
items.cn: expenditura 指付出去的钱。

items.en: Expenditure is used in accounts.
items.cn: expenditure 出现在账目用语中。

items.en: Expenditure covers money and energy used.
items.cn: expenditure 涵盖花掉的钱与消耗的精力。

items.en: Public expenditure is a common phrase.
items.cn: public expenditure 成为常用搭配。

note.en: Expenditure is money paid out; an expedition is a journey.
note.cn: expenditure 是支出，expedition 则是远征。

entries.definition: able to be used up or sacrificed

normalIntro.en: Expenditure is the money or energy you pay out.
normalIntro.cn: expenditure 就是你付出去的钱或精力。

normal.en: The city reduced expenditure on new roads.
normal.cn: 市里削减了新修道路的开支。

normal.en: Capital expenditure rose with the new factory.
normal.cn: 随着新工厂建设，资本支出上升。

normal.en: They kept a record of every expenditure.
normal.cn: 他们记录每一笔支出。

normal.en: The rescue needed a great expenditure of effort.
normal.cn: 那次救援耗费了巨大的努力。

normal.en: Health expenditure takes a large share of the budget.
normal.cn: 医疗开支占预算的很大一部分。

abstract.en: Picture coins weighed on a small scale.
abstract.cn: 想象硬币在小秤上被称量。

abstract.en: Imagine a ledger with columns of payments.
abstract.cn: 想象一本记满付款栏目的账簿。

abstract.en: Think of energy pouring out like water.
abstract.cn: 想象精力像水一样流出去。

examples.en: The report tracks government expenditure each year.
examples.cn: 这份报告追踪每年的政府开支。

examples.en: They argued about the expenditure on the new bridge.
examples.cn: 他们为修建新桥的开支争论不休。

examples.en: The task demanded a large expenditure of time.
examples.cn: 这项任务需要投入大量时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expenditure」里有 expend（花费）：把钱包里的钱向外称出去，就是「支出」。

root: 拉丁语 expendere（称量后支付）由 ex-（向外）与 pendere（称量）构成，核心义「把钱称出去」。

sensesIntro.en: Expenditure means money spent, a budget item, or the use of time and energy.
sensesIntro.cn: expenditure 意为花掉的钱、一笔经费，或时间与精力的消耗。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: money weighed and paid out.
core.cn: 核心意象：把钱包称量后付出去。

branches.en: The base sense is money paid out.
branches.cn: 基础义是付出的钱。

branches.en: Payments are grouped into budget lines.
branches.cn: 付款被归入预算项目。

branches.en: Paying out extends to effort and time.
branches.cn: 「付出」扩展到精力与时间。

branches.en: Total spending and single items pair together.
branches.cn: 总支出与单项经费相互对应。

branches.en: Money and energy are both resources spent.
branches.cn: 金钱与精力都是被消耗的资源。

intro.en: Expenditure builds on expend with the suffix -ure.
intro.cn: expenditure 在 expend 后加后缀 -ure。

latinIntro.en: Latin expendere and expenditura supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 expendere 与 expenditura 提供核心词形。

items.example: Pendere gives the image of weighing money.
items.exampleCN: pendere 提供称量钱币的形象。

items.example: Expendere is the source of expend.
items.exampleCN: expendere 是 expend 的来源。

items.example: Expendable describes what can be lost.
items.exampleCN: expendable 描述可以消耗掉的东西。

definition_en: the money needed or spent for something; something that costs money; the loss or sacrifice involved
core_image: 为得到某样东西而付出的钱
scene: 他把差旅费用记在了公司账上。He put the travel expenses on the company account.
sceneCN: 这里 expense 是「费用、开支」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把差旅费用记在了公司账上。

senses.title: Cost of something
senses.definition: the money needed or spent for something
senses.definitionCN: 为某事物所需或所花的钱
senses.example: The expense of the trip was too high.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行的费用太高了。
senses.why: The base sense is money laid out.
senses.whyCN: 基础义是付出去的钱。

senses.title: Money for work
senses.definition: money spent for a particular purpose, often repaid by an employer
senses.definitionCN: 为特定用途支出、常由雇主报销的钱
senses.example: She kept every receipt to claim her expenses.
senses.exampleCN: 她保留每张收据以便报销。
senses.why: The cost is tied to a job or purpose.
senses.whyCN: 费用与工作或特定用途绑定。

senses.title: Price paid
senses.definition: the loss or sacrifice involved in gaining something
senses.definitionCN: 为获得某物而付出的损失或牺牲
senses.example: He won the race at the expense of his health.
senses.exampleCN: 他以健康为代价赢得了比赛。
senses.why: Money cost becomes any kind of cost.
senses.whyCN: 金钱成本扩展为任何代价。

intro.en: Expense comes from Latin expensa, money paid out.
intro.cn: expense 源自拉丁语 expensa，意为「付出去的钱」。

items.en: Expensa is money paid out.
items.cn: expensa 指付出去的钱。

items.en: Expendere means to weigh out and spend.
items.cn: expendere 意为称量后花费。

items.en: Espense keeps the sense of cost.
items.cn: espense 保留「花费」之义。

items.en: Expense enters as a business term.
items.cn: expense 作为商业用语进入英语。

items.en: Expense covers both cost and sacrifice.
items.cn: expense 同时涵盖费用与牺牲。

items.en: At the expense of is a fixed phrase.
items.cn: at the expense of 成为固定搭配。

note.en: Expense is money spent; an expanse is a wide area.
note.cn: expense 是花掉的钱，expanse 则是广阔区域。

entries.definition: a wide area of land or space
to use up money or energy
an amount asked for a service
the money needed to buy something

normalIntro.en: Expense is what you pay in money or in other ways.
normalIntro.cn: expense 是你付出的钱或其他代价。

normal.en: The trip was worth the expense.
normal.cn: 这趟旅行花这些钱是值得的。

normal.en: They spared no expense on the wedding.
normal.cn: 他们为婚礼不惜花费。

normal.en: He learned the skill at the expense of his free time.
normal.cn: 他以牺牲空闲时间为代价学会了这项技能。

normal.en: Living expenses in the city keep rising.
normal.cn: 城市生活费用不断上涨。

normal.en: Keep the receipt to record the expense.
normal.cn: 保留收据以便记录这笔开支。

abstract.en: Picture a price tag on a distant dream.
abstract.cn: 想象遥远梦想上挂着价签。

abstract.en: Imagine trading time for a skill.
abstract.cn: 想象用时间换取一项技能。

abstract.en: Think of a receipt that proves a cost.
abstract.cn: 想象一张证明成本的收据。

examples.en: The company covers travel expenses for staff.
examples.cn: 公司为员工报销差旅费。

examples.en: They built the tower at the expense of the old park.
examples.cn: 他们以牺牲老公园为代价建起了高塔。

examples.en: The expense of heating the house shocked them.
examples.cn: 供暖费用让他们大吃一惊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expense」里有 ex（向外）+ pens（称量付钱）：向外付钱，就是「费用」。

root: 拉丁语 expensa（付出之钱）来自 expendere（称量后支付），核心义「为得到某物付出的钱」。

sensesIntro.en: Expense means the cost of something, money spent for work, or the sacrifice involved.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: money laid down for something wanted.
core.cn: 核心意象：为想要的东西掏出的钱。

branches.en: The base sense is the cost of something.
branches.cn: 基础义是某物的费用。

branches.en: Costs are tied to work and can be repaid.
branches.cn: 费用与工作相关并可报销。

branches.en: A money cost becomes any sacrifice.
branches.cn: 金钱成本成为任何牺牲。

branches.en: General cost and work costs overlap.
branches.cn: 一般费用与公务开支相互重叠。

branches.en: Price and sacrifice share one idea of cost.
branches.cn: 价钱与牺牲共享同一个成本概念。

intro.en: Expense goes back to Latin expendere, to pay out.
intro.cn: expense 可追溯到拉丁语 expendere，意为付出钱。

latinIntro.en: Latin expensa and expendere supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 expensa 与 expendere 提供核心词形。

definition_zh: 昂贵的；代价高的；奢华的
definition_en: costing a lot of money; causing a serious loss; belonging to a high-priced and luxurious class
core_image: 价签上的数字大得让人犹豫
scene: 这台相机太贵，他决定再等一等。The camera was too expensive, so he decided to wait.
sceneCN: 这里 expensive 是「昂贵的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这台相机太贵，他决定再等一等。

senses.title: Costing a lot
senses.definition: costing a lot of money
senses.definitionCN: 需要花很多钱的
senses.example: That watch is far too expensive.
senses.exampleCN: 那块表太贵了。
senses.why: The core sense is a high price.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是高昂的价格。

senses.title: Costly in loss
senses.definition: causing a serious loss of money or other things
senses.definitionCN: 造成金钱或其他方面严重损失的
senses.example: The delay proved an expensive mistake.

root: 拉丁语 explosio（轰走）来自 explodere（拍手轰下台），其「猛然爆发出去」的形象演变为「爆炸」。

sensesIntro.en: Explosion means a violent burst, an outburst of emotion, or a rapid increase.
sensesIntro.cn: explosion 意为猛烈爆炸、情绪爆发，或迅速增长。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sealed thing bursting with a bang.
core.cn: 核心意象：封闭之物轰然炸开。

branches.en: The base sense is a violent burst.
branches.cn: 基础义是猛烈爆炸。

branches.en: The burst becomes an emotional outburst.
branches.cn: 炸开变成情绪爆发。

branches.en: The burst becomes a rapid increase.
branches.cn: 炸开变成迅速增长。

branches.en: Both are sudden and hard to control.
branches.cn: 两者都突然且难以控制。

branches.en: A blast and a boom both expand fast.
branches.cn: 爆炸与激增都迅速扩张。

intro.en: Explosion adds the noun suffix -sion to Latin explodere.
intro.cn: explosion 在拉丁语 explodere 基础上加名词后缀 -sion。

latinIntro.en: Latin explodere and explosio supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 explodere 与 explosio 提供核心词形。

items.exampleCN: explosive 加上了形容词词尾。

definition_en: to send goods to another country; to spread ideas or skills abroad; goods sold abroad
core_image: 装满货物的集装箱驶向海外港口
scene: 这家公司向欧洲出口机器。The company exports machines to Europe.
sceneCN: 这里 export 是「出口货物」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这家公司向欧洲出口机器。

senses.title: Sell goods abroad
senses.definition: to send goods to another country for sale
senses.definitionCN: 把货物运往另一国家销售
senses.example: The country exports coffee and bananas.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家出口咖啡和香蕉。
senses.why: The core sense is carrying goods out.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是把货物运出去。

senses.title: Spread ideas abroad
senses.definition: to spread ideas, skills, or culture to other places
senses.definitionCN: 把思想、技术或文化传播到其他地方
senses.example: The university exports its teaching methods.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学输出自己的教学方法。
senses.why: Goods are replaced by ideas that travel out.
senses.whyCN: 货物被向外传播的思想所取代。

senses.title: Goods sold abroad
senses.definition: goods or services sold to another country
senses.definitionCN: 卖到另一国家的商品或服务
senses.example: Oil is the country's main export.
senses.exampleCN: 石油是这个国家的主要出口商品。
senses.why: The action becomes the thing being sent.
senses.whyCN: 动作变成被运出的东西。

intro.en: Export comes from Latin exportare, to carry out, from ex- out and portare to carry.
intro.cn: export 来自拉丁语 exportare（运出去），由 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Portare means to carry.
items.cn: portare 意为搬运。

items.en: Exportare means to carry out.
items.cn: exportare 意为运出去。

items.en: Export names trade that sends goods away.
items.cn: export 指把货物运往外的贸易。

items.en: Export also covers ideas and services.
items.cn: 现代英语中 export 也涵盖思想与服务。

note.en: Export means send out; import means bring in.
note.cn: export 是运出去，import 则是运进来。

entries.definition: to bring goods into a country
to carry from one place to another

normalIntro.en: Export is about goods and ideas carried out of a country.
normalIntro.cn: export 指货物与思想被运出一个国家。

normal.en: Brazil exports coffee to many countries.
normal.cn: 巴西向许多国家出口咖啡。

normal.en: The firm exports software to Asia.
normal.cn: 这家公司向亚洲出口软件。

normal.en: Tea was once a major export of China.
normal.cn: 茶叶曾是中国的主要出口商品。

normal.en: New rules made exporting easier.
normal.cn: 新规定让出口变得更容易。

normal.en: The port handles exports every day.
normal.cn: 这个港口每天处理出口货物。

abstract.en: Picture a ship loaded with boxes leaving port.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘装满箱子的船驶离港口。

abstract.en: Imagine a teacher sharing a method with another country.
abstract.cn: 想象一位老师把方法传到另一个国家。

abstract.en: Think of a map with arrows pointing outward.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，箭头全都指向外面。

examples.en: They export wine to Europe and America.
examples.cn: 他们把葡萄酒出口到欧洲和美洲。

examples.en: The country depends on oil exports.
examples.cn: 这个国家依赖石油出口。

examples.en: The company began exporting last year.
examples.cn: 这家公司去年开始出口。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 port（搬运）：把货物搬向国外，就是 export（出口）。

root: 源自拉丁语 exportare（运出去），由 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成，核心义「把货物或观念运出去」。

sensesIntro.en: Export means to sell goods abroad, to spread ideas outward, or goods sold abroad.
sensesIntro.cn: export 意为向国外销售货物、向外传播思想，或出口商品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a container ship heading for a foreign port.
core.cn: 核心意象：驶向海外港口的集装箱船。

branches.en: The base sense is sending goods abroad.
branches.cn: 基础义是把货物运往国外。

branches.en: Goods are replaced by ideas that travel out.
branches.cn: 货物被向外传播的思想取代。

branches.en: The action becomes the goods themselves.
branches.cn: 动作变成货物本身。

branches.en: Trade and cultural spread both move outward.
branches.cn: 贸易与文化传播都向外流动。

branches.en: The act of exporting and the exports themselves are linked.
branches.cn: 出口行为与出口商品相互关联。

intro.en: Export is built on Latin ex- out and portare to carry, the same root as transport.
intro.cn: export 由拉丁语 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成，与 transport 同根。

latinIntro.en: Latin exportare, portare, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exportare、portare 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.meaning: to send goods abroad or such goods
items.example: They export rice to nearby markets.
items.exampleCN: 他们把大米出口到邻近市场。

items.structure: English verb form and plural noun
items.meaningCN: 出口（第三人称）；出口商品
items.exampleCN: 这个国家的出口大幅上升。

items.example: The exported fruit arrives by sea.
items.exampleCN: 出口的水果经海运输达。
出口需要仔细处理文书。

items.meaning: a person or country that exports
items.example: China is a major exporter of electronics.
items.exampleCN: 中国是电子产品的主要出口国。

items.example: The law controls the exportation of arms.

items.meaning: to carry from place to place

items.exampleCN: -port 出现在 export 与 import 中。

definition_en: to leave something open to danger or influence; to reveal a truth; to give someone experience of something
core_image: 遮布被掀开，里面的东西露在光下
scene: 不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下。Do not expose your skin to the sun for long.
sceneCN: 这里 expose 是「使暴露于」（第 1 个义项）；句意：不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下。

senses.title: Leave open to harm
senses.definition: to leave someone or something open to danger, weather, or influence
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某物处于危险、天气或影响之下
senses.example: The damaged roof exposed the room to rain.
senses.exampleCN: 损坏的屋顶让雨水淋进了房间。
senses.why: The core sense is removing cover or protection.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是去掉遮盖或保护。

senses.title: Reveal a truth
senses.definition: to make a secret or wrong doing public
senses.definitionCN: 把秘密或错误行为公开
senses.example: The report exposed serious waste.
senses.exampleCN: 报告揭露了严重的浪费。
senses.why: Physical uncovering becomes moral disclosure.
senses.whyCN: 物理上的揭开转为道德上的揭发。

senses.title: Give experience
senses.definition: to give someone experience of something new
senses.definitionCN: 让某人接触或体验新事物
senses.example: Travel exposes children to other cultures.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行让孩子们接触其他文化。
senses.why: Being open to influence becomes learning.
senses.whyCN: 向影响敞开变成学习的过程。

intro.en: Expose comes from Latin exponere, to put out, from ex- out and ponere to place.
intro.cn: expose 来自拉丁语 exponere（放出去），由 ex-（向外）与 ponere（放置）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Ponere means to place.
items.cn: ponere 意为放置。

items.en: Exponere means to put out or set forth.
items.cn: exponere 意为放出或陈述。

items.en: Exposer carries the sense of setting out.
items.cn: 古法语 exposer 保留「摆出来」之义。

items.en: Expose means to uncover or reveal.
items.cn: 现代英语中 expose 意为使暴露或揭露。

note.en: Expose means uncover; oppose means stand against.
note.cn: expose 是揭开，oppose 则是反对。

entries.definition: to disagree with and try to stop
to remove a cover or find a secret

normalIntro.en: Expose is about taking away cover, whether from skin or from a secret.
normalIntro.cn: expose 指去掉遮盖，无论是皮肤上的还是秘密上的。

normal.en: Do not expose the film to bright light.
normal.cn: 不要让胶片暴露在强光下。

normal.en: The newspaper exposed the false claims.
normal.cn: 报纸揭露了那些虚假说法。

normal.en: Workers were exposed to dangerous fumes.
normal.cn: 工人们接触到了危险气体。

normal.en: The scandal exposed weak controls.
normal.cn: 这起丑闻暴露出监管薄弱。

normal.en: Good teachers expose students to new ideas.
normal.cn: 好老师让学生接触新思想。

abstract.en: Picture a cloth pulled away from a hidden object.
abstract.cn: 想象一块布从隐藏的物体上被拉开。

abstract.en: Imagine a spotlight falling on a dark corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一束聚光灯照进黑暗的角落。

abstract.en: Think of a door opened to let fresh air in.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门打开，让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: The report exposed waste in the department.
examples.cn: 报告揭露了该部门的浪费。

examples.en: Children should not be exposed to violence.
examples.cn: 不应让儿童接触暴力。

examples.en: The storm exposed the weakness of the roof.
examples.cn: 暴风雨暴露了屋顶的弱点。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 pose（放置）：把东西放到外面、不再遮住，就是 expose（暴露）。

root: 源自拉丁语 exponere（放出去），由 ex-（向外）与 ponere（放置）构成，核心义「去掉遮盖，使显露」。

sensesIntro.en: Expose means to leave something unprotected, to reveal a truth, or to give someone new experience.
sensesIntro.cn: expose 意为使失去保护、揭露真相，或让某人获得新体验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cover lifted off something hidden.
core.cn: 核心意象：遮盖物被从隐藏之物上掀开。

branches.en: The base sense is opening to harm.
branches.cn: 基础义是向伤害敞开。

branches.en: Physical uncovering becomes public disclosure.
branches.cn: 物理上的揭开变成公开揭露。

branches.en: Being open to influence becomes learning.
branches.cn: 向影响敞开变成学习。

branches.en: A hidden fault can be exposed to view.
branches.cn: 隐藏的缺陷可以被暴露在眼前。

branches.en: Exposure to risk and exposure to new ideas share the same openness.
branches.cn: 暴露于风险与接触新思想都带有「敞开」之意。

intro.en: Expose belongs to the Latin ponere family, like expose and composition.
intro.cn: expose 属于拉丁语 ponere 词族，与 composition 等词同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin exponere, ponere, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exponere、ponere 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.exampleCN: 他们揭露了有问题的线路。
这项测试暴露出薄弱之处。

items.example: The exposed pipe froze in winter.
items.exampleCN: 暴露的管道冬天冻住了。

items.example: Exposure to cold can be dangerous.

items.meaning: a full explanation or public show
items.example: The book begins with a short exposition.
items.exampleCN: 这本书以简短的阐述开篇。

items.example: The material is exposable to sunlight.
items.exampleCN: 这种材料可以暴露在阳光下。
许多居民反对这个计划。

items.meaning: to place an idea before oneself
items.example: I suppose he will arrive soon.

latinEntries.meaning: to put out or set forth

definition_en: to show thoughts or feelings; to send something quickly; fast and direct; a fast train or service
core_image: 把心里的想法像挤牙膏一样压出来，让对方看见
scene: 她很难表达自己的感受。She found it hard to express her feelings.
sceneCN: 这里 express 是「表达、表示」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她很难表达自己的感受。

senses.title: Show thoughts
senses.definition: to show thoughts, feelings, or ideas in words or actions
senses.definitionCN: 用语言或行动表现思想、感情或想法
senses.example: He expressed his thanks with a letter.
senses.exampleCN: 他写信表达了自己的感谢。
senses.why: The core sense is pressing something out into view.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是把内心的东西压出来让人看见。

senses.title: Send quickly
senses.definition: to send something by a fast service
senses.definitionCN: 通过快速服务寄送某物
senses.example: Please express the parcel to London.
senses.exampleCN: 请把包裹快递到伦敦。
senses.why: Pressing out becomes pressing forward in speed.
senses.whyCN: 「压出」转为速度上的「快速送达」。

senses.title: Fast and direct
senses.definition: fast, direct, and making few stops
senses.definitionCN: 快速、直达且停站很少的
senses.example: We took the express train to the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 我们乘特快列车去了海边。
senses.why: The idea of direct movement becomes a travel word.
senses.whyCN: 直达移动的概念变成交通用语。

senses.title: A fast service
senses.definition: a fast train or a quick delivery service
senses.definitionCN: 快速列车或快速递送服务
senses.example: The express leaves at seven.
senses.exampleCN: 快车七点出发。
senses.why: The adjective becomes a noun for the service.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转为表示该服务的名词。

intro.en: Express comes from Latin exprimere, to press out, from ex- out and premere to press.
intro.cn: express 来自拉丁语 exprimere（压出来），由 ex-（向外）与 premere（压）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Premere means to press.
items.cn: premere 意为压。

items.en: Exprimere means to press out.
items.cn: exprimere 意为压出来。

items.en: Express keeps the sense of making clear.
items.cn: 古法语中 express 保留「使清楚」之义。

items.en: Express also means fast and direct.
items.cn: 现代英语中 express 也表示快速直达。

note.en: Express means press out; impress means press in.
note.cn: express 是压出来，impress 则是压进去、留下印象。

entries.definition: to press something into less space
to communicate an idea or feeling

normalIntro.en: Express moves from pressing feelings out to sending things fast.
normalIntro.cn: express 从「把感情压出来」发展到「快速寄送」。

normal.en: She expressed her thanks in a short speech.
normal.cn: 她用简短的讲话表达了感谢。

normal.en: The letter was expressed to New York.
normal.cn: 这封信被快递到纽约。

normal.en: They took the express to the capital.
normal.cn: 他们乘快车去了首都。

normal.en: Art allows people to express strong feelings.
normal.cn: 艺术让人们表达强烈的情感。

normal.en: The express service costs a little more.
normal.cn: 快递服务费用稍高一些。

abstract.en: Picture words being squeezed out of a full heart.
abstract.cn: 想象话语从满怀情感的心里被挤出来。

abstract.en: Imagine a train passing every small station.
abstract.cn: 想象一列火车掠过每个小站。

abstract.en: Think of a letter racing across the map.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信在地图上飞驰。

examples.en: He could not express his anger in words.
examples.cn: 他无法用语言表达自己的愤怒。

examples.en: The package was expressed overnight.
examples.cn: 包裹连夜快递出去了。

examples.en: The express stops only at major cities.
examples.cn: 这趟快车只在大城市停靠。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 press（压）：把心里的想法压出来，就是 express（表达）。

root: 源自拉丁语 exprimere（压出来），由 ex-（向外）与 premere（压）构成，核心义「把内在之物压出、送达」。

sensesIntro.en: Express means to show thoughts, to send quickly, to be fast and direct, or a fast service.
sensesIntro.cn: express 意为表达思想、快速寄送、快速直达，或快车服务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: words pressed out into the open.
core.cn: 核心意象：话语被压出来、显露于外。

branches.en: The base sense is pressing thoughts into view.
branches.cn: 基础义是把思想压出来让人看见。

branches.en: Pressing out becomes sending quickly.
branches.cn: 「压出」变成「快速寄送」。

branches.en: Speed and directness become travel qualities.
branches.cn: 速度与直达变成交通特征。

branches.en: The adjective becomes a noun for the service.
branches.cn: 形容词转为表示该服务的名词。

branches.en: Fast sending and fast service share the same speed.
branches.cn: 快速寄送与快速服务共享同一种速度。

intro.en: Express belongs to the Latin premere family, like compress and impress.
intro.cn: express 属于拉丁语 premere 词族，与 compress、impress 同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin exprimere, premere, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exprimere、premere 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.exampleCN: 这首诗表达了深深的悲痛。
他平静地表达了自己的看法。

items.example: She wrote a letter expressing thanks.
items.exampleCN: 她写了一封表示感谢的信。

items.meaning: the act of showing or a look on the face

items.example: She has a very expressive face.
items.exampleCN: 她有一张很富表现力的脸。

items.meaning: to press in and leave a strong effect
items.exampleCN: 演讲给观众留下了深刻印象。

items.example: They compress the data into a small file.
items.exampleCN: 他们把数据压缩成一个小文件。

definition_en: the act of showing thoughts or feelings; a look on the face; a word or phrase; a group of symbols in mathematics
core_image: 一张脸上清晰写出的喜怒，以及说出口的一句话
scene: 她的脸上露出惊讶的表情。A look of surprise appeared in her expression.
sceneCN: 这里 expression 是「表情」（第 2 个义项）；句意：她的脸上露出惊讶的表情。

senses.title: Showing feelings
senses.definition: the act of showing thoughts or feelings
senses.definitionCN: 表现思想或感情的行为
senses.example: Music gives her a way of expression.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐给了她一种表达方式。
senses.why: The core sense is pressing something out into view.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是把内心的东西压出来让人看见。

senses.title: A look on the face
senses.definition: a look that shows what someone feels
senses.definitionCN: 显示某人感受的面部神情
senses.example: His expression softened when he saw the child.
senses.exampleCN: 看到孩子时，他的表情柔和下来。
senses.why: Inner feeling becomes visible on the face.
senses.whyCN: 内心的感受在脸上变得可见。

senses.title: A word or phrase
senses.definition: a word or group of words used in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以特定方式使用的词或词组
senses.example: That expression is common in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 那种说法在北方很常见。
senses.why: A way of speaking becomes a fixed phrase.
senses.whyCN: 一种说话方式变成固定的词语。

senses.title: Mathematical symbols
senses.definition: a group of symbols that shows a mathematical idea
senses.definitionCN: 表示数学概念的一组符号
senses.example: The student simplified the expression.
senses.exampleCN: 学生化简了这个表达式。
senses.why: A clear statement of meaning becomes a symbol group.
senses.whyCN: 清楚表达含义变成一组符号。

intro.en: Expression comes from Latin expressio, from exprimere, to press out.
intro.cn: expression 来自拉丁语 expressio，根源是 exprimere（压出来）。

items.en: Exprimere means to press out.
items.cn: exprimere 意为压出来。

items.en: Expressio means a pressing out.
items.cn: expressio 意为压出。

items.en: Expression keeps the sense of making clear.
items.cn: 古法语中 expression 保留「使清楚」之义。

items.en: Expression names both the act and the look.
items.cn: expression 同时指表达行为与神情。

items.en: Expression also names phrases and formulas.
items.cn: 现代英语中 expression 也指词语与公式。

note.en: Expression is what comes out; impression is what goes in.
note.cn: expression 是表达出来的东西，impression 则是留在心里的印象。

entries.definition: an idea or feeling left in the mind
the words used to say something

normalIntro.en: Expression is the noun of express, covering feelings, faces, phrases, and formulas.
normalIntro.cn: expression 是 express 的名词，涵盖情感、表情、词语与公式。

normal.en: Her expression showed that she was tired.
normal.cn: 她的表情说明她累了。

normal.en: Freedom of expression is protected by law.
normal.cn: 表达自由受法律保护。

normal.en: He used a polite expression to refuse.
normal.cn: 他用礼貌的说法拒绝了。

normal.en: The teacher explained the mathematical expression.
normal.cn: 老师讲解了这个数学表达式。

normal.en: Dance is a powerful form of expression.
normal.cn: 舞蹈是一种有力的表达形式。

abstract.en: Picture a face that says everything without a word.
abstract.cn: 想象一张不用说话就能说明一切的脸。

abstract.en: Imagine a phrase repeated by a whole town.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话被整个小镇反复使用。

abstract.en: Think of symbols lined up like a short sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象符号排成一列，像一句简短的话。

examples.en: Her expression changed when she heard the name.
examples.cn: 听到那个名字时，她的表情变了。

examples.en: The essay is full of vivid expressions.
examples.cn: 这篇文章充满生动的表达。

examples.en: Simplify the expression before solving it.
examples.cn: 解之前先化简这个表达式。

dict_mnemonic.text: express 加名词后缀 -ion，表示「表达出来的东西」，就是 expression。

root: 源自拉丁语 expressio（压出），由 exprimere 派生，核心义「把内在之物表达出来」及其结果。

sensesIntro.en: Expression means the act of showing feeling, a facial look, a phrase, or a mathematical formula.
sensesIntro.cn: expression 意为表达行为、面部表情、词语说法，或数学表达式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: feeling pressed out onto a face or into words.
core.cn: 核心意象：情感被压出到脸上或话语里。

branches.en: The base sense is the act of showing feeling.
branches.cn: 基础义是表现感情的行为。

branches.en: Feeling becomes visible on the face.
branches.cn: 感受在脸上变得可见。

branches.en: A way of speaking becomes a fixed phrase.
branches.cn: 说话方式变成固定词语。

branches.en: Clear meaning becomes a group of symbols.
branches.cn: 清楚的含义变成一组符号。

branches.en: Inner expression and facial expression are closely linked.
branches.cn: 内在表达与面部表情紧密相连。

intro.en: Expression is express plus -ion, a common Latin noun ending.
intro.cn: expression 由 express 加 -ion 构成，-ion 是常见的拉丁名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin expressio and exprimere are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 expressio 与 exprimere 是来源形式。

items.meaning: the act or result of expressing

items.example: He watched with an expressionless face.

items.meaning: a feeling left in the mind
items.example: The city made a strong impression.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市给人留下深刻印象。

definition_en: to reach out over an area; to make longer or larger; to stretch out a hand; to offer help or an invitation
core_image: 一条路从脚下一直伸向远方的地平线
scene: 这条小路一直延伸到河边。The path extends to the river.
sceneCN: 这里 extend 是「延伸」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这条小路一直延伸到河边。

senses.title: Reach across space
senses.definition: to reach out or continue over an area
senses.definitionCN: 在某片区域上伸展或延续
senses.example: The forest extends for miles.
senses.exampleCN: 森林延伸数英里。
senses.why: The core sense is stretching out in space.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是在空间中向外伸展。

senses.title: Make longer or larger
senses.definition: to make something longer, larger, or later
senses.definitionCN: 使某物更长、更大或更晚
senses.example: They extended the meeting by an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把会议延长了一小时。
senses.why: Stretching in space becomes stretching in time or size.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的拉伸变成时间或规模上的延长。

senses.title: Stretch out a hand
senses.definition: to stretch out a part of the body
senses.definitionCN: 伸出身体的某一部分
senses.example: He extended his hand in greeting.
senses.exampleCN: 他伸出手来表示问候。
senses.why: The body repeats the outward stretch.
senses.whyCN: 身体重复了向外伸展的动作。

senses.title: Offer to someone
senses.definition: to offer help, thanks, or an invitation
senses.definitionCN: 给予帮助、感谢或邀请
senses.example: The school extended a warm welcome to us.
senses.exampleCN: 学校向我们表示了热烈欢迎。
senses.why: Reaching outward becomes offering something.
senses.whyCN: 向外伸手变成给出某物。

intro.en: Extend comes from Latin extendere, to stretch out, from ex- out and tendere to stretch.
intro.cn: extend 来自拉丁语 extendere（向外拉伸），由 ex-（向外）与 tendere（拉）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Tendere means to stretch.
items.cn: tendere 意为拉伸。

items.en: Extendere means to stretch out.
items.cn: extendere 意为向外拉伸。

items.en: Extendre keeps the outward stretch.
items.cn: 古法语 extendre 保留向外伸展之义。

items.en: Extend covers space, time, and offers.
items.cn: 现代英语中 extend 涵盖空间、时间与给予。

note.en: Extend means stretch out; intend means plan.
note.cn: extend 是伸展开，intend 则是打算。

entries.definition: to go to an event or place

normalIntro.en: Extend is the act of stretching something outward in space, time, or gesture.
normalIntro.cn: extend 是把事物在空间、时间或动作上向外伸展。

normal.en: The garden extends down to the lake.
normal.cn: 花园一直延伸到湖边。

normal.en: They extended the deadline by two days.
normal.cn: 他们把截止日期延长了两天。

normal.en: She extended her hand to help him up.
normal.cn: 她伸手把他扶起来。

normal.en: The company extended an offer to her.
normal.cn: 公司向她发出了聘用邀请。

normal.en: The shelf extends along the whole wall.
normal.cn: 架子沿着整面墙延伸。

abstract.en: Picture a road running straight to the horizon.
abstract.cn: 想象一条路笔直伸向地平线。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand reaching across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸过桌面。

abstract.en: Think of a calendar with extra days added.
abstract.cn: 想象日历上又添了几天。

examples.en: The desert extends far beyond the town.
examples.cn: 沙漠远远延伸到城镇之外。

examples.en: We extended the visit for another week.
examples.cn: 我们把访问又延长了一周。

examples.en: He extended his hand to the visitor.
examples.cn: 他向访客伸出了手。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 tend（拉伸）：向外拉长，就是 extend（延伸、延长）。

root: 源自拉丁语 extendere（向外拉伸），由 ex-（向外）与 tendere（拉）构成，核心义「向外伸展」。

sensesIntro.en: Extend means to reach across space, make longer or larger, stretch out a hand, or offer something.
sensesIntro.cn: extend 意为在空间中延伸、使更长更大、伸出手，或给予某物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a road stretching to the horizon.
core.cn: 核心意象：伸向地平线的一条路。

branches.en: The base sense is stretching across space.
branches.cn: 基础义是在空间中伸展。

branches.en: Stretching becomes longer time or larger size.
branches.cn: 伸展变成时间更长或规模更大。

branches.en: The body repeats the outward stretch.
branches.cn: 身体重复向外伸展的动作。

branches.en: Reaching out becomes giving or offering.
branches.cn: 向外伸出变成给予或提供。

branches.en: Spatial reach and temporal extension share one motion.
branches.cn: 空间延伸与时间延长共享同一动作。

intro.en: Extend belongs to the Latin tendere family, like extend, intend, and attend.
intro.cn: extend 属于拉丁语 tendere 词族，与 intend、attend 同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin extendere, tendere, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extendere、tendere 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.example: The line extends to the door.
The offer extends to all students.
items.exampleCN: 这项优惠面向所有学生。
这座房子有宽阔的花园。

items.meaning: the size or degree of something
items.example: The extent of the damage is unclear.

items.meaning: the state of being stretched tight
a habit of moving or acting in one way
items.example: He has a tendency to arrive late.

definition_zh: 延伸；扩建部分；延期；电话分机
definition_en: the act of making something longer or larger; an added part of a building; extra time; a phone line connected to one system
core_image: 原本的房屋旁边又接出一间，电话线也分出一条
scene: 我们申请延长截止日期。We asked for an extension of the deadline.
sceneCN: 这里 extension 是「延期」（第 3 个义项）；句意：我们申请延长截止日期。

senses.title: The act of extending
senses.definition: the act of making something longer or larger
senses.definitionCN: 使某物更长或更大的行为
senses.example: The extension of the railway took two years.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路的延伸用了两年。
senses.why: The core sense is the act of stretching out.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是向外伸展的行为。

senses.title: An added part
senses.definition: an extra part added to a building
senses.definitionCN: 加建在建筑物上的额外部分
senses.example: They built a small extension at the back.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在后面建了一个小扩建部分。
senses.why: The act becomes the added structure.
senses.whyCN: 动作变成加建的结构。

senses.title: Extra time
senses.definition: extra time allowed to finish something
senses.definitionCN: 为完成某事而允许的额外时间
senses.example: The teacher gave us an extension.
senses.exampleCN: 老师给了我们延期。
senses.why: Stretching in space becomes stretching in time.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的延伸变成时间上的延长。

senses.title: Phone line
senses.definition: a phone line connected to a main line
senses.definitionCN: 连接到主线上的电话分线
senses.example: Call me on extension twenty two.
senses.exampleCN: 请拨分机二十二找我。
senses.why: A branch line extends from the main one.
senses.whyCN: 分线从主线上延伸出来。

intro.en: Extension comes from Latin extensio, from extendere, to stretch out.
intro.cn: extension 来自拉丁语 extensio，根源是 extendere（向外拉伸）。

items.en: Extendere means to stretch out.
items.cn: extendere 意为向外拉伸。

items.en: Extensio means a stretching out.
items.cn: extensio 意为向外伸展。

items.en: Extension keeps the sense of enlargement.
items.cn: 古法语中 extension 保留「扩大」之义。

items.en: Extension names an added part or extra time.
items.cn: extension 指加建部分或额外时间。

items.en: Extension also means a phone branch line.
items.cn: 现代英语中 extension 也指电话分机。

note.en: Extension adds length; tension is tightness.
note.cn: extension 是延长，tension 则是拉紧。

entries.definition: the state of being stretched tight
the act of watching or listening carefully
the act of making something last longer
an extra building added to a main one

normalIntro.en: Extension is the noun of extend, covering added space, added time, and added phone lines.
normalIntro.cn: extension 是 extend 的名词，涵盖加建空间、延长时间与电话分线。

normal.en: The library needs an extension at the back.
normal.cn: 图书馆需要在后面加建一部分。

normal.en: She asked for an extension on the essay.
normal.cn: 她申请延长交论文的期限。

normal.en: Please dial extension thirty five.
normal.cn: 请拨分机三十五。

normal.en: The extension of the road eased traffic.
normal.cn: 道路的延伸缓解了交通。

normal.en: He plugged the lamp into an extension lead.
normal.cn: 他把台灯插到延长线插座上。

abstract.en: Picture a small room added to the side of a house.
abstract.cn: 想象房子侧面加出一个小房间。

abstract.en: Imagine a clock whose hands move more slowly.
abstract.cn: 想象一只指针走得更慢的钟。

abstract.en: Think of one main road splitting into a side lane.
abstract.cn: 想象一条主路分出一条侧道。

examples.en: The council approved the extension of the school.
examples.cn: 议会批准了学校的扩建。

examples.en: He was given a two week extension.
examples.cn: 他获得了两周的延期。

examples.en: Her office extension is not working.
examples.cn: 她办公室的分机坏了。

dict_mnemonic.text: extend 加名词后缀 -sion，表示「延伸出来的部分」，就是 extension。

root: 源自拉丁语 extensio（向外伸展），由 extendere 派生，核心义「延伸、加出来的部分」。

sensesIntro.en: Extension means the act of extending, an added building, extra time, or a phone branch line.
sensesIntro.cn: extension 意为延伸行为、加建部分、额外时间，或电话分机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a new room attached to an old house.
core.cn: 核心意象：老房子旁新接出的一间房。

branches.en: The base sense is the act of stretching out.
branches.cn: 基础义是向外伸展的行为。

branches.en: The act becomes an added structure.
branches.cn: 动作变成加建的结构。

branches.en: Stretching in space becomes extra time.
branches.cn: 空间延伸变成额外时间。

branches.en: A branch line extends from the main line.
branches.cn: 分线从主线上延伸出来。

branches.en: The act of extending and its built result are linked.
branches.cn: 延伸行为与其建成的结果相互关联。

intro.en: Extension is extend plus -sion, a noun ending seen in expansion and tension.
intro.cn: extension 由 extend 加 -sion 构成，-sion 是见于 expansion、tension 的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin extensio and extendere are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extensio 与 extendere 是来源形式。

items.meaning: the act of extending or an added part
items.example: The extension was finished in May.

items.meaning: several added parts or branch lines

items.example: They extend the service in winter.
items.exampleCN: 他们在冬天延长服务时间。

items.example: The extent of the loss is unknown.

definition_en: covering a large area; very great in amount; wide in range
core_image: 一片望不到边的田野铺展在眼前
scene: 这场风暴造成了广泛破坏。The storm caused extensive damage.
sceneCN: 这里 extensive 是「大量的、大规模的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：这场风暴造成了广泛破坏。

senses.title: Wide in range
senses.definition: covering a large area or range
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖大片区域或很大范围的
senses.example: The project required extensive research.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目需要广泛的研究。
senses.why: The core sense is a wide stretch of coverage.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是覆盖面的大幅铺展。

senses.title: Very great in amount
senses.definition: very great in amount or degree
senses.definitionCN: 数量或程度非常大的
senses.example: The flood caused extensive damage.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水造成了大规模破坏。
senses.why: Wide range becomes great amount.
senses.whyCN: 宽广的范围变成巨大的数量。

senses.title: Covering much land
senses.definition: covering a large area of land
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖大片土地的
senses.example: The house has extensive gardens.
senses.exampleCN: 这座房子有宽阔的花园。
senses.why: The stretch of space is the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 空间的铺展是最早的含义。

intro.en: Extensive comes from Latin extensivus, from extendere, to stretch out.
intro.cn: extensive 来自拉丁语 extensivus，根源是 extendere（向外拉伸）。

items.en: Extendere means to stretch out.
items.cn: extendere 意为向外拉伸。

items.en: Extensivus means tending to stretch out.
items.cn: extensivus 意为倾向于向外伸展的。

items.en: Extensive describes wide areas and large amounts.
items.cn: extensive 描述广阔区域与大量事物。

items.en: Extensive appears in research and damage.
items.cn: 现代英语中 extensive 常用于研究与破坏。

items.en: Extend, extension, and extent share the root.
items.cn: extend、extension 与 extent 共享同一词根。

note.en: Extensive means wide; intensive means deep and concentrated.
note.cn: extensive 是广泛的，intensive 则是密集深入的。

entries.definition: involving a lot of effort in a short time

normalIntro.en: Extensive describes things that spread wide or reach a great amount.
normalIntro.cn: extensive 描述铺展得很广或数量很大的事物。

normal.en: The report is based on extensive research.
normal.cn: 这份报告基于广泛的研究。

normal.en: The fire caused extensive damage to the forest.
normal.cn: 大火对森林造成了大规模破坏。

normal.en: She has extensive knowledge of local history.
normal.cn: 她对当地历史有广博的知识。

normal.en: The estate has extensive grounds.
normal.cn: 这座庄园有宽阔的场地。

normal.en: Extensive use of plastic worries scientists.
normal.cn: 塑料的广泛使用让科学家担忧。

abstract.en: Picture a field that runs far beyond sight.
abstract.cn: 想象一片一直延伸到视线之外的田野。

abstract.en: Imagine a map covered with many small marks.
abstract.cn: 想象一张布满许多小标记的地图。

abstract.en: Think of a library with shelves in every room.
abstract.cn: 想象一座每个房间都摆满书架的图书馆。

examples.en: The storm caused extensive damage to the coast.
examples.cn: 风暴对海岸造成了大规模破坏。

examples.en: They carried out extensive tests.
examples.cn: 他们进行了广泛的测试。

examples.en: The castle has extensive gardens.
examples.cn: 这座城堡有宽阔的花园。

dict_mnemonic.text: extend（延伸）加 -ive：延伸得很开的，就是 extensive（广泛的）。

root: 源自拉丁语 extensivus，由 extendere（向外拉伸）派生，核心义「铺展得很广、数量很大」。

sensesIntro.en: Extensive means wide in range, very great in amount, or covering much land.
sensesIntro.cn: extensive 意为范围广泛、数量巨大，或覆盖大片土地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a field stretching beyond sight.
core.cn: 核心意象：延伸到视线之外的田野。

branches.en: The base sense is wide coverage.
branches.cn: 基础义是宽广的覆盖范围。

branches.en: Wide range becomes a great amount.
branches.cn: 宽广范围变成巨大数量。

branches.en: The oldest sense is land stretched out.
branches.cn: 最早的含义是铺展开的土地。

branches.en: Wide range and large amount often go together.
branches.cn: 范围广与数量大常常相伴。

branches.en: Coverage in research and in land share the same width.
branches.cn: 研究范围与土地面积共享同一种「广」。

intro.en: Extensive is extend plus -ive, and it belongs to the same family as extension and extent.
intro.cn: extensive 由 extend 加 -ive 构成，与 extension、extent 同族。

latinIntro.en: Latin extensivus and extendere are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extensivus 与 extendere 是来源形式。

items.meaning: in a wide or thorough way

items.exampleCN: 这个课题已被广泛研究。

items.example: They measured the extensiveness of the damage.
